_doc: Curated corrections applied by scripts/build_city_gazetteer.py on top of the GeoNames extract.

nationalCapitalIds._doc: Countries whose capital GeoNames does not mark PPLC, or marks more than once. Value: GeoNames id. Source: GeoNames countryInfo.txt capital column.

countryCodes._doc: Cities whose centroid the boundary file puts in another country than the one the city belongs to.

partsOf._doc: Places that are parts of another gazetteer city: not cities of their own (they would steal stays from it under nearest-centroid matching) but extra match areas of the parent. Key: parent GeoNames id.

additionalSubdivisions._doc: Cities spanning several of the app's subdivisions. Value: the extra subdivision keys (CC-CODE) a stay may resolve to.
